Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: CloudWare renewal & expansion MAP — kickoff, stakeholder alignment, usage review

Hi Janelle / Rajiv —

Thanks for taking the time last week to review the renewal timing. As discussed, we put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on goals, owners, and an evaluation timeline that covers both the renewal and the proposed expansion (vector search tier + Dedicated capacity pilot). The attached MAP is a working document — we expect updates as stakeholders weigh in.

High-level objectives we recommend:
- Stabilize unit cost: target 18% reduction via batching and quantization by EoQ
- Improve P99 latency from 420ms -> 300ms for user-facing routes
- Pilot Dedicated capacity for the analytics ingestion pipeline (start 30-day trial)
- Evaluate the vector-search upsell on a 30-day sample workload

Proposed kickoff timeline:
- Today: MAP shared, stakeholders added, baseline usage reviewed
- Week of Aug 17: technical ramp + quantization recommendation from Redwood (Marcus)
- Week of Aug 24: procurement/contract cadence and pricing term comparison
- Target close date: Sep 21 (aligned with CloudWare fiscal close)

Action items for this thread: please confirm the following by EOD Wed 8/12 so we can lock owners in the MAP:
1) Primary technical owner for the Dedicated pilot
2) Procurement contact for contract timeline and PO cadence
3) Any additional success metrics (beyond cost/latency/uptake) you want tracked

Attachments: CloudWare_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with owner columns), usage-snapshot-Jul2026.csv (token & route breakdown)

Happy to jump on a short sync if helpful — I can open a calendar block for 30 minutes.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

1) Technical owner for the Dedicated pilot: Rajiv (cc'd) will own the pilot and will loop in our infra lead for the initial enablement.
